relevance_rank_note: Isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4 human iPSC neurons (two pairs): EEA1 early-endosome puncta and total EEA1, an endosome-marker surrogate for receptor recycling; no receptor surface or recycling assay.

description: Isogenic APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons had more EEA1-positive early-endosome puncta per cell than parental APOE3 neurons.
quote: We found that the number of EEA1 puncta was higher in APOE4 neurons compared to their APOE3 counterparts.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more EEA1+ early endosomes per neuron)
system: Human iPSC-derived neurons (NGN2 induction, 4 weeks), isogenic pair: APOE3 parental (Coriell AG09173) vs CRISPR-edited APOE4; neurons fed conditioned medium from control human astrocytes; EEA1 immunocytochemistry, n=6 from three independent cultures, Student's t-test. In-vitro iPSC-derived (fetal-like) neurons; conditioned medium carries astrocyte ApoE of unstated genotype. Donor note: APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 (75-year-old unaffected female) edited to APOE4; second pair Coriell AG10788 (87-year-old female, sporadic AD, APOE4/4) edited to APOE3. Both are the shared donors used by 33027662, 42239208 (AG09173) and 43026723, 29946028 (AG10788); 33027662 cites these pairs to this paper.
human_check: Bars read off Fig 2F: APOE3 ~55 vs APOE4 ~95 puncta per cell. *** bracket joins APOE3 and APOE4; legend key ***P<0.001. Author manuscript (PMC) read, cited as published Neuron version. AG09173 is the same donor as 33027662's first pair and 42239208's AG09173 set; likely the same edited lines (same lab).

description: Total EEA1 level (mean intensity x area) was higher in isogenic APOE4 than APOE3 iPSC-derived neurons.
quote: Total EEA1 levels, quantified as the product of ‘mean intensity of signal’ and ‘area covered by signal’, were also increased in APOE4 neurons (Figure 2F).

description: Second isogenic pair (sporadic AD APOE4/4 parental vs edited APOE3): APOE4 neurons had more EEA1 puncta than APOE3 neurons, but the difference was not significant (P=0.06).
quote: Also, while converting APOE4 to APOE3 appeared to reduce the number of early endosomes in neurons, the effect did not reach significance (P=0.06, Figure S6E).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more EEA1+ puncta per neuron, NS) [AGAINST]
system: Human iPSC-derived neurons (NGN2 induction), second isogenic pair: APOE4/4 parental line from a sporadic AD donor (Coriell AG10788) vs CRISPR-edited APOE3 (with an off-target TRIOBP Ala/Val variant); EEA1 immunocytochemistry, n=6 from three independent cultures, Student's t-test.
